summary: Undelivered reports to Invardia support no longer reach your inbox or raise early warnings.

fixes.title: Undelivered reports no longer mail you
fixes.text: A report to Invardia support that could not be delivered is retried and never mailed to you. The Invardia support link turns amber only after three failed rounds in a row.

fixes.title: Rights list matches what PIM Manager does
fixes.text: The approved rights list now matches the product; the updater keeps reading SuperAdmins' mail addresses for alerts.
